correctness.rationale: For compact-operator algebras, the standard quotient embeds isometrically as a dense subspace of an explicit l2-sum of Hilbert--Schmidt spaces; it is onto exactly when the state support projection lies in the c0-sum, equivalently has finitely many finite-rank blocks. That condition also makes every module quotient equivalent to the closed subspace Ep. For C0(X), the standard quotient is the C0(X) image in L2(mu), which is complete exactly for finite support; finite-point interpolation then proves the every-module direction. Explicit infinite-support examples independently verify failure.

originality.rationale: The inspected arXiv:2609.13944v1 proves its actual completeness statements under purity, despite broader wording in the abstract. Searches for GNS quotient completeness, finite-rank states, support projections, compact-operator algebras, and finite-support measures did not locate the two sharp arbitrary-state criteria or the stated completion model. Standard ingredients and pure-state completeness are excluded from the novelty claim.

value.rationale: The result gives a sharp repair and extension of a recent completeness claim: purity is not necessary, finite-support mixed states are allowed, and every infinite-support state is ruled out already by the standard module. The compact-operator case also receives an explicit Hilbert--Schmidt completion model.
